[package]
name = "xl-vector-scan"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Zero-dependency prototype of the XeLibrary exact-vector candidate scan (issue #40)"
license = "Apache-2.0"
publish = false

[profile.release]
lto = true
codegen-units = 1

[[bin]]
name = "xl-vector-scan"
path = "src/main.rs"

[workspace]
members = ["crates/*", "adapters/postgres-service"]
resolver = "2"

[workspace.package]
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
version = "0.1.0"

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
strip = true

[package]
name = "psios-common"
edition.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
version.workspace = true

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
sha2 = "0.10"
uuid = "1"

[package]
name = "psios-host-io"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
publish = false

[dependencies]
libc = "0.2"
serde_json = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"

[package]
name = "psios-broker-core"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
publish = false

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["macros", "sync", "time"] }
uuid = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["macros", "rt", "test-util"] }

[package]
name = "psios-event-core"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
publish = false

[dependencies]
base64 = "0.22"
chrono = "0.4"
hmac = "0.12"
rand = "0.8"
sha2 = "0.10"

[package]
name = "psios-plugin-contracts"
edition.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
version.workspace = true

[dependencies]
base64 = "0.22"
ed25519-dalek = { version = "2", features = ["pkcs8", "pem"] }
http = "1"
jsonschema = { version = "0.18", default-features = false, features = ["draft202012"] }
rustix = { version = "1", features = ["fs"] }
psios-common = { path = "../common" }
semver = "1"
serde_json = "1"
uuid = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"

[package]
name = "psios-security"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
publish = false

[dependencies]
argon2 = "0.5"
base64 = "0.22"
chrono = "0.4"
hmac = "0.12"
ipnet = "2"
libc = "0.2"
psios-common = { path = "../common" }
psios-host-io = { path = "../host-io" }
rand = "0.8"
rcgen = { version = "0.13", features = ["x509-parser"] }
ring = "0.17"
serde_json = "1"
sha2 = "0.10"
time = "0.3"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["rt", "sync"] }
uuid = { version = "1", features = ["v4"] }
zeroize = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["macros", "time"] }

[package]
name = "psios-workflow"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
publish = false

[dependencies]
jsonschema = { version = "0.18", default-features = false, features = ["draft202012"] }
serde_json = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["macros", "rt"] }

[package]
name = "psios-task-engine"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
publish = false

[dependencies]
chrono = "0.4"
serde_json = "1"
uuid = "1"

[package]
name = "psios-signed-artifact-candidate"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
publish = false

[workspace]

[features]
ordinary-profile-cli = ["dep:clap", "dep:libc", "dep:psios-postgres-service"]

[dependencies]
clap = { version = "4", optional = true, features = ["derive"] }
libc = { version = "0.2", optional = true }
psios-common = { path = "../../crates/common" }
psios-plugin-contracts = { path = "../../crates/plugin-contracts" }
psios-postgres-service = { path = "../../adapters/postgres-service", optional = true }
serde_json = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"

[[bin]]
name = "psios-validate-artifact"
path = "src/main.rs"
required-features = ["ordinary-profile-cli"]
